en: Improved the messages shown when `/ultrareview`, a cloud session or a cloud agent finds no GitHub remote: they now say to create a repository at [https://github.com/new](https://github.com/new), and `/ultrareview` no longer suggests a `gh` command that `gh` rejects
zh: 改进 `/ultrareview`、云 session 或云 agent 未找到 GitHub remote 时的提示信息：现在会提示在 [https://github.com/new](https://github.com/new) 创建仓库，且 `/ultrareview` 不再建议使用会被 `gh` 拒绝的 `gh` 命令
